summary: Ghostwriting on LinkedIn requires capturing an executive's authentic voice, extracting proprietary insights, and packaging them into high-converting posts. whoFor: Freelance writers and copywriters transitioning into high-ticket executive ghostwriting.
Content marketers and agency operators looking to scale LinkedIn content production without sacrificing authenticity.
Founders and executives who want to build an internal AI-assisted personal branding engine.
Learners who want to master no-code AI agent workflows and voice replication frameworks.
outcomes: A configured multi-agent LinkedIn ghostwriting architecture with research, drafting, and feedback nodes.
A comprehensive Executive Voice Dossier and tonality rulebook for a target founder.
A 4-week, 12-post thought leadership campaign ready for client delivery.
An automated Slack/chat review interface for real-time post iterations.

No-code agent builder (Relevance AI, Make, or n8n).
Communication & capture workspace (Slack, Notion, or Google Docs).
LinkedIn Analytics or Shield Analytics for performance benchmarking.
objectives: Architect a multi-agent AI ghostwriting system separating research, initial drafting, and tone critique.
Conduct structured founder extraction interviews and build an actionable Executive Voice Matrix.
Configure automated research agents to monitor industry news, trending topics, and competitor benchmarks.
Implement strict Anti-AI formatting and tone guardrails that eliminate robotic boilerplate language.
Deploy a chat-based review pipeline (via Slack/Notion) for friction-free client feedback and rapid iterations.
Package, price, and pitch retainer-based LinkedIn ghostwriting services to 7-figure executives.

lessons.title: Introduction to AI Ghostwriting & Architecture
lessons.notes: Explores the fundamental shift from manual freelance writing to AI-augmented ghostwriting. The lesson deconstructs why single-prompt LLM generation produces generic, easily detectable LinkedIn content. It introduces the multi-agent paradigm: decoupling information gathering, draft synthesis, and voice tuning into distinct computational steps to preserve founder authenticity.
lessons.activity: Map out a 3-agent ghostwriting workflow on paper or digital canvas (Researcher -> Drafter -> Critic) and identify the specific inputs required at each stage.
lessons.reflection: Why do single-prompt LinkedIn posts almost always sound like generic marketing copy, and how does multi-agent separation solve this?

lessons.title: Live Ghostwriting Agent Demonstration & Output Inspection
lessons.notes: Demonstrates a functioning ghostwriting agent running live. Analyzes the differences between raw LLM output and agentic output conditioned on specific founder voice parameters. The lesson highlights key evaluation criteria: hook strength, line spacing, conversational rhythm, story-to-insight ratio, and call-to-conversation endings.
lessons.activity: Take a sample generic AI-generated LinkedIn post and manually annotate every instance of generic phrasing, passive voice, or artificial buzzwords.
lessons.reflection: What are the three most noticeable 'AI tells' on LinkedIn, and what specific rules can prevent them?

lessons.title: Building the Topic & Industry Research Agent
lessons.notes: Step-by-step build of the Research Agent. Covers scraping niche newsletters, parsing RSS feeds, extracting trending news from industry portals, and identifying content gaps. Shows how to engineer system instructions that force the agent to extract specific data points, contrarian angles, and actionable case studies rather than surface-level summaries.
lessons.activity: Build and test the system prompt for a Research Agent targeting a specific industry (e.g., B2B SaaS or FinTech) and verify that it outputs 5 concrete story angles.
lessons.reflection: How does providing primary research data improve the Information Gain score of an AI-assisted post?

lessons.title: Configuring the Copywriting & Tone-Feedback Agent
lessons.notes: Focuses on the core drafting and feedback loops. Implements the Executive Voice Matrix: sentence length distribution, vocabulary constraints, preferred hook templates (e.g., 'Contrarian Take', 'Behind-the-Scenes Breakdown', 'Hard Truth'), and paragraph structures. Integrates a Critic Agent that scores drafts against brand guidelines before human review.
lessons.activity: Configure a Critic Agent prompt that scores drafts from 1-10 on Voice Match, Hook Punchiness, and Jargon Absence, with mandatory rewrite suggestions.
lessons.reflection: Why is a dedicated critique step more reliable than asking the drafter agent to 'check its own work' in a single prompt?

lessons.title: Creating a Slack Assistant for Instant AI Drafting & Editing
lessons.notes: Connects the AI agent backend to Slack using webhook triggers and conversational bots. Demonstrates how a ghostwriter or founder can drop a 30-second voice note, rough bullet points, or an article link into Slack and receive three polished, tone-aligned LinkedIn drafts within seconds, complete with revision options.
lessons.activity: Configure a webhook or test harness that accepts a raw bullet-point input and returns two formatted LinkedIn draft variations.
lessons.reflection: How does lowering the friction of capturing founder thoughts in real time increase the quality of ghostwritten content?

lessons.title: Advanced Workflow Optimization, Quality Control & Client Delivery

Teaches how to conduct a 45-minute monthly interview that fuels an entire month of content, how to present drafts in a client-friendly approval portal, and how to track engagement metrics to refine the agent prompts over time.

summary: Modern photography retouching has evolved from tedious hours of manual frequency separation and stamp cloning to AI-assisted workflows that deliver magazine-grade portraits in seconds while preserving authentic skin texture. This course covers the complete workflow for AI skin smoothing, glare elimination, garment wrinkle removal, and commercial image finishing.
whoFor: Portrait and commercial photographers wanting to reduce editing turnaround times from days to hours.
Photo editors and retouchers looking to integrate generative AI tools into Photoshop and Lightroom workflows.
Content creators, agencies, and e-commerce brands producing high-volume product and model imagery.
Beginners who want to learn professional skin retouching principles without getting lost in complex manual masks.
outcomes: A 5-image commercial portrait retouching portfolio demonstrating skin smoothing, glare removal, and fabric cleanup.
A customized AI Retouching Action/Preset workflow for high-volume batch processing.
A non-destructive Photoshop/Lightroom master file archive with layer-based adjustment stacks.
A client delivery package with high-resolution web, print, and social exports.
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with digital photography concepts (RAW formats, exposure, resolution) and image editing software.
tools: Adobe Photoshop with Generative Fill / Neural Filters, or Evoto AI / Luminar Neo.
Adobe Lightroom Classic or Capture One for RAW ingestion and color grading.
High-resolution sample portrait images (RAW or uncompressed TIFF/JPEG).
Color-calibrated display and cloud storage for project deliverables.

Factual / MCQ: Identify key performance indicators, formatting constraints, and standard architectural requirements in Design & Brand.
Applied / Short Answer: Demonstrate proficiency in configuring tools and executing hands-on workflows directly taught in the verified video.
Applied / Short Answer: Formulate structured prompt sequences and multi-step parameters to generate high-quality outputs for commercial use.
Applied / Short Answer: Execute pre-flight verification, troubleshooting, and error-handling steps to resolve common production bottlenecks.
Reasoning / Essay: Analyze the ethical considerations, commercial trade-offs, and quality-control standards governing human oversight of AI workflows in AI Photography & Retouching.
Reasoning / Essay: Formulate an end-to-end implementation roadmap justifying strategic decisions for an enterprise or client project.

lessons.title: Introduction to Modern AI Retouching Workflows
lessons.notes: Introduces the paradigm shift in digital photography post-production. Compares traditional multi-hour manual retouching methods with modern AI-accelerated techniques. Establishes the core philosophy of professional AI retouching: AI should be used as a precision accelerator to handle repetitive pixel manipulation while human artistic direction controls final texture, realism, and aesthetic consistency.
lessons.activity: Import three unretouched RAW portraits into your editing workspace and inspect them at 100% zoom to identify key areas requiring texture preservation versus smoothing.
lessons.reflection: Why is the preservation of authentic skin texture the single most critical standard separating professional AI retouching from amateur AI filters?

lessons.title: AI Skin Retouching & Natural Texture Smoothing
lessons.notes: Step-by-step masterclass on AI skin smoothing. Demonstrates how AI neural algorithms detect facial landmarks, analyze skin tones, and smooth out blotchiness, redness, and blemishes without erasing natural skin pores. Teaches how to adjust AI smoothing intensity, mask out sensitive facial zones (eyes, lips, nostrils), and blend the AI layer with the underlying base image.
lessons.activity: Apply AI skin smoothing to a portrait, adjust the effect intensity to 60-70%, and paint a layer mask to keep the eyes and lips completely sharp.
lessons.reflection: How does layer blending and opacity control prevent the over-processed 'plastic mannequin' look common in automated retouching?

lessons.title: AI-Powered Glare & Reflection Removal
lessons.notes: Focuses on one of the hardest manual retouching challenges: removing harsh reflections and studio light glare from eyeglasses. Demonstrates how generative inpainting analyzes the visible iris and eyelid structure behind the glass to reconstruct the eye naturally while eliminating reflective flare and color fringing.
lessons.activity: Select a portrait with eyeglass glare, use precision lasso selection around the glare artifact, and execute AI inpainting to reconstruct the eye naturally.
lessons.reflection: What visual cues must be verified after inpainting eyeglasses to ensure the subject's gaze and eye symmetry remain anatomically correct?

lessons.title: Automated Garment Wrinkle Removal & Fabric Cleanup
lessons.notes: Covers commercial wardrobe and fabric retouching. Demonstrates using generative AI to smooth deep creases, iron out distracting fabric wrinkles on shirts and suits, and remove lint/dust particles without destroying the natural weave and structure of the textile.
lessons.activity: Select a corporate headshot with wrinkled clothing, apply AI fabric smoothing across the shoulders and chest, and verify that the garment seams remain intact.
lessons.reflection: Why is wardrobe cleanup essential in commercial and corporate headshot photography, and how does AI make it commercially viable?

lessons.title: Master Export, Visual QA, and Color Consistency
lessons.notes: Final assembly, quality assurance, and commercial delivery. Covers reviewing the full image stack at 100% and 200% magnification, checking for edge artifacts or unnatural blur halos, applying global color grading and sharpening, and exporting high-bitrate master files formatted for print (CMYK/AdobeRGB) and web (sRGB).
lessons.activity: Perform a complete 5-point QA inspection on your finished portrait and export high-resolution master deliverables for both web and print.
lessons.reflection: What are the final quality checks required before delivering an AI-retouched image to a commercial client?

common_mistakes: Over-smoothing skin into plastic
Setting AI smoothing slider to 100%. Fix: Dial back opacity to 60-75% and inspect pore detail.
Distorting eye anatomy during glare removal
Letting AI hallucinate a different eye shape. Fix: Use smaller selection brushes and reference the second eye for symmetry.
Erasing garment seams
Selecting across structural cloth lines. Fix: Mask along seam boundaries to preserve garment structure.
Exporting in wrong color profiles
Delivering AdobeRGB to web clients causing dull, washed-out colors. Fix: Always convert to sRGB for digital delivery.

title: AI Project Management
videoTitle: How to Use AI for Project Management: Claude + Notion Workflow Guide
summary: Project management is undergoing a fundamental transformation through artificial intelligence. This course teaches project managers, Scrum masters, and team leads how to harness Claude 3 and advanced LLMs to automate project scoping, generate dynamic Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), create Mermaid/Gantt charts, streamline stakeholder communications, and manage project risks adaptively.
whoFor: Project managers, Scrum masters, and PMO leads looking to 10x their planning and reporting velocity.
Operations managers and startup founders managing cross-functional technical initiatives.
Team leads looking to automate status reports, meeting summaries, and stakeholder briefings.
Professionals preparing for AI-augmented project leadership certifications.
outcomes: A comprehensive AI-generated Project Charter and Work Breakdown Structure (WBS).
A dynamic, code-rendered Gantt chart with critical path dependencies and resource leveling.
An automated Stakeholder Communications Engine with custom briefings for C-suite and engineering.
An Adaptive Risk Management Matrix with automated scenario modeling and contingency triggers.
prerequisites: Basic understanding of project management principles (Agile, Waterfall, Gantt charts, WBS).
tools: Claude 3.5 Sonnet or ChatGPT Plus for advanced reasoning and artifact generation.
Notion, ClickUp, or Asana for task tracking and project boards.
Mermaid.js live editor or Markdown previewer for dynamic chart rendering.
Google Sheets or Excel for resource and budget allocation.
objectives: Formulate AI-driven project management frameworks that automate project planning, task decomposition, and resource allocation.
Translate ambiguous business requirements and executive briefs into structured Work Breakdown Structures (WBS) and SMART milestones using advanced LLM prompting.
Generate dynamic Mermaid/Gantt timeline visualizations, critical path schedules, and dependency matrices using AI reasoning models.
Build automated stakeholder communication systems, executive briefing generators, and status update pipelines tailored to diverse organizational roles.
Implement adaptive agile risk assessment matrices, scenario simulations, and contingency triggers to preempt project bottlenecks.
Establish continuous project health monitoring, sprint retrospectives, and post-launch review protocols powered by AI assistance.

lessons.title: Next-Gen Project Management Frameworks with AI

Establishes the foundational principles of feeding structured project context into LLMs to generate high-fidelity management artifacts.

lessons.reflection: Why does AI excel at task decomposition and risk forecasting compared to manual spreadsheet planning?

lessons.title: AI-Driven Project Scoping, Work Breakdown & SMART Goals
lessons.notes: Demonstrates prompt engineering techniques for transforming ambiguous client briefs into hierarchical Work Breakdown Structures (WBS). Covers defining Level 1 phases, Level 2 deliverables, and Level 3 work packages with precise effort estimation, resource assignments, and SMART acceptance criteria.
lessons.activity: Prompt Claude/ChatGPT with a raw product concept to generate a 3-level WBS containing at least 20 granular work packages.
lessons.reflection: How does enforcing SMART acceptance criteria in AI prompts prevent scope creep during sprint execution?

lessons.title: Generating Dynamic Gantt Charts & Timelines with Claude 3

lessons.activity: Generate a Mermaid.js Gantt chart code block for a 12-week project and render it in a live Mermaid viewer to verify sequence accuracy.
lessons.reflection: What are the advantages of maintaining project schedules in text/code formats over proprietary static software files?

lessons.title: AI Tools for Effective Stakeholder Management & Communication
lessons.notes: Explores building role-based communication pipelines. Demonstrates how to take a single weekly sprint data log and generate three customized reports: (1) Executive Summary for C-suite (ROI, milestones, blockers), (2) Technical Deep-Dive for engineering, and (3) Client Progress Update for external partners.
lessons.activity: Create a multi-persona reporting prompt that converts a raw list of 10 completed tasks and 2 delays into 3 distinct stakeholder memos.
lessons.reflection: Why is tailored stakeholder communication essential for maintaining executive confidence during project delays?

lessons.title: Adaptive Agile Strategies, Risk Forecasting & Resource Allocation

Failing to update risk matrices after scope changes
Treating the risk matrix as a one-time document. Fix: Re-run the AI risk simulation whenever deadlines or requirements change.

common_mistakes: Failing to verify Stripe webhook signatures

Updating database permissions on frontend redirect instead of webhook

Hardcoding Stripe Price IDs
Hardcoding IDs into component templates. Fix: Store Price IDs in environment variables or configuration files.
